text:
Sliding through the water,

I have come as far as the Island.

I have wandered among its breezes.

And along its coast I have run.


I came out of the sea full of seaweed,

my bathing suit clinging tight.

And after walking through the Island,

I slept beneath a tree.


What sumptuous solitude!

What splendid solitude!

And what a fatiguing life,

the life of the city!

translation.title: Sliding Through the Water...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the island as a bodily escape from the exhausting city.
